column1: # Any ESP32 variant with 16MB. Any device role.
# Verify a board's real flash with:  esptool.py --port COMx flash_id
# NOTE: many 16MB modules ship with a PlatformIO board definition that
# claims 8MB. If the build says "does not fit in configured flash size"
#   0x00D000   otadata       8 KB   which app slot to boot
#   0x810000   storage    7.94 MB   staging area for firmware images
# App slots are oversized against a ~1 MB firmware. Deliberate - the
# chip has 16MB and nothing else needs it. The storage partition is
# the useful part: it holds firmware for OTHER devices so this board
# can push updates over the air.
